hardware: UNVERIFIED; future real-user beta/release checks, not unfinished static implementation
comparison: Separate post-freeze comparison from updated origin/main. No prior family implementation is credited as equivalent to MotoMotion. HA architecture reuse is expressed by concrete code/test groups.
numeric_contract: Nonempty ASCII decimal strings0..signedMAX with arbitrarily many leading zeroes. Each native ADD wraps before RGB zero / D remainder. Stores survive later parse failure; event names are asynchronous, not model snapshots. Helpers and action-admitted values remain separate.
product_boundary: Only direct BLE bed features. WiFi, SSID/password, network administration, cloud/account/OTA and unrelated camera/companion infrastructure are excluded as recorded, not implementation debt. HA adapter/proxy/setup remains supported.
ha_runtime_repairs_counting: These four HA integration defects are scoped repairs of existing coverage, not new artifact discoveries or extra credit for the316candidate/144command coverage views.

coverage.counting: Ledger identifiers, command rows, aliases and audit checks are overlapping coverage views, never a count of distinct features.
